svg.title: An ordinary alert
svg.desc: Keep the room ordinary and the changing alert small but legible. The first signal enters a routine human workflow, with no spectacle implying responders already know the whole compromise. Reuse the flat lights and blank telemetry wall through the response sequence; background screens introduce no additional findings.
